text:
alice.h: heads-up — post-canary metrics show eu-west-1 dedicated inference pool p95 latency jumped from ~220ms -> ~520ms after model redwood/llama-2-13b@v2.3.1 rollout. 5xx rose to ~0.6% (baseline ~0.02%).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 15% in eu-west-1. Rule triggered: p95>500ms sustained 5m. Suggested actions: pause-canary | rollback-region.

carla-sre: oncall looking now. do we have any infra churn? any config flags changed with this deploy? @ben.platform

ben.platform: no infra changes. suspect kv-cache invalidations under fp16 quantized path in v2.3.1. not seeing GC/host issues. recommend targeted rollback for eu-west-1 only — avoid global revert.

david-eng: +1. Plan proposal: pin routing in eu-west-1 to v2.3.0, drop canary to 0, run 10m smoke, then either unpin or escalate to full rollback. keep customers informed.

alice.h: good. also want release-notes + customer comms for EU tenants. @release-notes-bot please create a draft note and add link.

release-notes-bot: Draft created — "Temporary rollback of v2.3.1 in eu-west-1 due to latency regression; investigating." Ticket RF-472. Link: https://intranet/release-notes/345

carla-sre: preparing to execute targeted pin now. share command to run, @ben.platform?

ben.platform: run the targeted route update and verify metrics:
```
# pin traffic in eu-west-1 to model v2.3.0
redwoodctl routes update --region eu-west-1 --model redwood/llama-2-13b@v2.3.0 --force
# reduce canary weight to 0 if still set
redwoodctl rollouts update --canary-weight 0 --region eu-west-1
# smoke and monitor
redwoodctl metrics tail --region eu-west-1 --filter "p95,5xx" --window 10m
```

carla-sre: executing in 30s. will report back with p95/5xx at 1m/3m/10m marks.

deploy-bot: Action: Manual override initiated by carla-sre. Canary paused. Automated rollback disabled for this thread.

alice.h: notify CS + enterprise owners for EU dedicated pools. @david-eng can you send outreach with the draft? use incident template.

david-eng: drafting and sending now to CS. adding list of affected tenants + expected ETA for patch.

carla-sre: rollback/pin applied. immediate telemetry: p95 ~230ms, 5xx ~0.03% after ~3m. looks stable so far. keeping pin active until patch. creating postmortem ticket and adding logs. :thumbsup:

ben.platform: digging into logs/repro to confirm kv-cache invalidation path. will run repro job in eu-west-1 image; ETA ~8h for root cause + patch plan. I'll also add a changelog note.

release-notes-bot: Updated note: "Rollback complete in eu-west-1; working on patch for v2.3.1 regression. Incident RF-472."

alice.h: owners: ben.platform (root cause + patch), david-eng (customer comms + release notes), carla-sre (monitoring + ops). schedule controlled rollout after patch with canary in off-peak EU window (overnight).

carla-sre: putting retention monitors on the pinned route and alerting thresholds to be extra sensitive for first 24h.

ben.platform: will open a PR for a fix and aim for a canary redeploy tomorrow night EU off-peak.

alice.h: thanks team. closing this thread for coordination; leave pin until patch verified and we run a controlled canary. follow-ups in RF-472.

carla-sre: :white_check_mark:

david-eng: thanks everyone.
